Method of Attack: Encrypts files on compromised machines, replaces the desktop wallpaper, and drops a ransom note that includes politically themed messages.
Encrypts files on compromised machines, adds a '.rcry' extension to the encrypted files, and displays a ransom note.
Attack Vector: The ransomware variant was hosted on a website with a URL containing the name of a private bank in India as a string, used as bait or to make the file look legitimate.
